initial.advice:
Verdict: The workspace and manual page already share cream backgrounds and teal accents, but oversized editorial headings displace the work: workspace title occupies roughly y220–330; manual fields begin only at y565. Workspace source cards clearly distinguish equipment CSV and clinical CSV, yet manual entry is not visible as a source choice; the PDF consent area at y800–970 uses very small supporting text. Manual inputs are narrow, visibly clipping “Not supplied,” while units and canonical keys are tiny; “Fill complete synthetic profile” is the dominant action above real entry. The index/evidence surface is visually separate—cool background, rust buttons, red status strip—and its five-line hero consumes y265–660 before substantive material. These are not yet a restrained, cohesive working app.
Next: 1) Establish a shared cream canvas, dark-teal navigation rail, white/cream panels, muted borders and teal primary actions across all three; use existing/system fonts, no remote font or tracking dependencies. Give the rail consistent Workspace / Manual entry / Evidence & limits destinations with explicit active states; replace the workspace’s large left manifesto with compact workflow guidance. Keep research-only restrictions prominent and readable, using warm warning treatments only for meaningful cautions. 2) Reduce page headings to approximately 32–40px desktop and 28–32px mobile, shorten introductory spacing, and bring source selection, form fields and evidence summary into the first viewport. Use 16px body/helper text, at least 14px for units/statuses, comfortable line spacing and strong text contrast; reserve small uppercase monospace for brief metadata, not disclosure paragraphs. 3) Workspace: present clearly named SECA CSV, Clinical inputs CSV and Manual entry choices together, each explaining accepted data and local handling. Place optional PDF extraction in a separate secondary panel; keep local inspection distinct from external extraction, preserve explicit unchecked consent and privacy disclosure, and make readiness/disabled states unambiguous. Retain file limits, parser behavior, original-page references and withdrawal controls. 4) Manual: put a genuine review/continue action at the appropriate form endpoint; demote synthetic fill into clearly labeled example-data tooling, with clear/reset secondary. Widen inputs so empty-state text fits; align labels, units and controls, and move canonical keys to optional technical detail without changing field contracts. Preserve blank-as-not-supplied semantics and distinguish missing, entered and invalid states without invented values. 5) Evidence/index: replace the giant hero and competing CTA rows with a compact Evidence & limits heading, readable research boundary summary and ordered source/evidence sections; retain every citation, evidence status, methods detail, disclosure and test hook. Keep blocked E-005 explicit; do not introduce numeric age outputs or validity claims. 6) At narrow widths, stack cards and field rows, wrap navigation/actions and long identifiers, and use disclosure/list treatments for dense evidence rather than page-wide overflow. Next judging views: matching 1440×1000 top views of all three after revision; full-page manual and evidence captures; 390×844 and 320px-wide views of each page including their bottom sections; workspace PDF selected/pre-consent and extraction-review states, imported-record review, manual blank/invalid/synthetic-filled states, and evidence expanded citations/statuses. Include original-resolution crops of PDF disclosures, manual labels/units/errors and dense evidence entries, plus visible keyboard-focus states.
Risk: Only initial desktop viewports are supplied; evidence/source content below the fold, manual submission controls, responsive behavior and interactive states cannot be assessed. The index screenshot shows the evidence disclosure collapsed, not its contents. Obtain expanded evidence views and a worker-reported content/test-contract preservation comparison before accepting that redesign; screenshots alone cannot verify parser preservation, test compliance, external requests or absence of horizontal overflow in all states.

companion_handoff:
# Companion handoff, 2026-10-08

Owned changes: docs/clinic-companion.html, docs/clinic-companion.css, docs/clinic-companion.js; meaningful tests at tests/clinic_companion.test.cjs. Preserved the original synthetic loop and all original recognizable IDs/export format. No commit/deploy by worker.

Current outcome: complete synthetic measurements -> save draft -> explicit approval -> patient Today -> check-in -> clinic follow-up -> local JSON download. Exact saved version/snapshot binding and field equality guards are enforced; edit/revoke clears check-in and hidden patient text; expiry closes patient/check-in/export. Approval remains synthetic, with no clinical authorization/readiness claim. Default review date is runtime +28 days. Fixed measured/derived provenance and missing measurement inputs/protocol copy. No backend/network/storage use.

Development evidence: node --check docs/clinic-companion.js; node --test tests/clinic_companion.test.cjs tests/workbench.test.cjs passed 14/14. Companion VM suite exercises actual event handlers including invalid dates, unsignaled mutation, edit/revoke/expiry, reset, aria-current/focus, selections and downloaded Blob content. Python Playwright .tmp/companion/verify_browser.py exercised complete rendered workflow, JSON download/readback, edit/revoke/expiry, invalid date, all 4 views at 320/390/768/1440 widths; no page errors or horizontal overflow. JSON readback 1549 bytes, exact approval/plan/snapshot, both measurement provenance dates, no participant name.

Visual-taste loop: Advisor attached baseline desktop/mobile, gave dark rail/readable text/snapshot/provenance/mobile hierarchy direction. First repaired call inspected eight requested workflow views (actual mobile top and action viewport; desktop measured/saved-plan/today/followup; mobile today; browser JSON). Warm teal/cream criteria met; selected desktop check-in was captured during pale-background transition. Repaired selected transition/hover; supplied original resting/hover/keyboard crops plus 320/768 saved-plan/followup and actual desktop today viewport. Final Advisor said targeted repairs resolved, no material visual defect, no requested view outstanding. Separate nonauthor QA still owns acceptance.

Advisor usage: initial 3720 tokens, repaired 12918 tokens, final 6808 tokens; total 23446 provider-reported tokens. decision_changed=true for initial dark-rail/mobile/provenance repairs, true for selected-control transition repair, false final. Receipts advisor-recheck-receipt.json and advisor-final-receipt.json; initial raw output retained in tool transcript.

Learning checkpoint: expected source-aware synthetic workflow; observed old prototype lacked grip date, treated derived BMI as measured, used stale fixed review date, and allowed expired export. Chosen correction: explicit derived/observed limitation, runtime review date, immutable saved plan with equality guard, and current-only export. Reuse exact date-clock boundary checks and JSON readback; avoid capturing controls during transitions because it misrepresents settled contrast. Layout is frozen after image-backed loop. Next owner: root integrates shared navigation/governance and independent reviewer executes acceptance before commit/deploy. E-005 remains blocked and no clinical/gov readiness is asserted.

- after-desktop.png: desktop measurements
- after-mobile-top.png / after-mobile-action.png: actual mobile viewports
- after-plan-saved.png: saved plan desktop
